title: BlackboardSourceRef.v1
description: A SOURCE reference posted to the blackboard: a stable provenance handle that observations/syntheses cite. handle is a content handle — a ctx:// resource handle or a doc#section locator (the pattern requires one of those forms) — so every cited source resolves to a real, addressable location, never free text. authority_rank is a numeric weight used during reconciliation (higher-authority sources win conflicts); it is graph data, not a display label. retrieved_at records when the source was read (freshness lineage).

source_id.description: unique id of this source reference (cited by entry source_refs[])

handle.description: stable provenance handle: a ctx:// resource handle or a doc#section locator — never free text

authority_rank.description: numeric authority weight for reconciliation (higher wins conflicts); graph data, not a display label

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this source was retrieved/read (freshness lineage)
